metadata.mechanics: At the end of the required time, all participants who were involved for the full 10 minutes may immediately refresh their Impact skills. The participants' next Impact skill refresh is extended to 30 minutes instead of the standard 20 minutes and may not be reduced by any means.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession Saint. Must be Inducted into the Light of Hedon
metadata.validTargetDescription: Self and up to 4 Targets Inducted into the Light of Hedon
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: Dedication to work is just as important as dedication to sensations for the Light of Hedon. This ritual involves the user of this Benediction aiding all targets through a 10-minute deep refocus and reprieve into a guided deep meditation. This may include steps of cleansing using water or salt as well as other religious accoutrement to assist in the creation of a deep focus gathering of a psionic “second wind”.
